title: Faster Impossible Craft
description: Makes the game faster like making time go faster, mobs, and more. Fun with friends.
body:
# Faster Impossible Craft

**_FIC_** is a mod that speeds up everything in the game that utilizes **TICKS** in a simple and easy way to understand. 

------

Commands: 

/setspeed <modifier> 


Notes: The setspeed command has a limit of 100 due to the increase of LAG, physics glitches, and AI not functioning correctly. The modifiers are (1 = 20 ticks) so for example (20 = 400 ticks).
